description.value: The Clam Bucket Restaurant is a seafood-focused destination on the Port Alberni waterfront, self-billed as 'world famous' for its West Coast seafood. Customer reviews highlight generous portions of fish and chips, chowder, salmon, and prawns, along with an outdoor patio that buzzes in season. It sits at the heart of Port Alberni's Victoria Quay, making it a natural and memorable stop for cyclists touring central Vancouver Island.

The website makes no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, takeout, or any cyclist-specific amenities, so those fields are null. A minor name discrepancy exists: OSM records 'Clam Bucket Restaurant' while the website consistently uses 'The Clam Bucket Restaurant' or 'The Clam Bucket'.
